intro: Outside of research, I like to travel, watch neflix, and track down nice restaurant and cafe (even though Champaign doesn't offer that many options). I'm always happy to chat, about any of this or anything else.

photos.alt: The U.S. Capitol across the reflecting pool under a pale winter sky
photos.title: Winter break
photos.description: The Capitol across the reflecting pool, on a winter-break trip.

photos.alt: A statue of a man reading on a bench, covered in snow, with a block of snow on its head
photos.title: Winter at Champaign
photos.description: The statue outside Grainger library, keeps reading under a hat of snow.

photos.alt: A young girl reading a booklet beside a stone table against a weathered garden wall
photos.title: Reading in the crowd
photos.description: Crowded temple, and one little girl reading through all of it.

photos.alt: Yellow ginkgo trees over a pale temple wall with dark roof tiles
photos.title: Xiyuan Temple
photos.description: Ginkgo season at Xiyuan Temple. The vegetarian noodles there are the best.

photos.alt: A two-tiered garden pavilion with upturned grey-tile eaves and a red plaque, framed by hanging green branches
photos.title: Small gardens
photos.description: I love wandering through Suzhou's smaller gardens and temples, and I'd recommend them to anyone visiting.

photos.alt: A violinist and a man under a glowing street lamp at dusk, city lights behind
photos.title: Street violin
photos.description: Violinist couple under a street lamp on Charles Bridge at blue hour.

photos.alt: Two people seen from behind on a riverside bench under a tree, the low sun breaking through the leaves and the old town across the water
photos.title: By the river
photos.description: Mother and daughter on a bench by the river, watching the sun go down. Felt so peaceful.

photos.alt: The Eiffel Tower from below, with the Olympic rings mounted on it, against clouds
photos.title: The tower with its rings
photos.description: The Eiffel Tower wearing the Olympic rings.

photos.alt: The Hungarian Parliament Building lit gold at night, reflected in the Danube
photos.title: Parliament at night
photos.description: The Hungarian Parliament lit up over the Danube.

photos.alt: A wooden counter with small dishes under a row of red lanterns, willows outside the window
photos.title: Lost in the old town
photos.description: Got separated from my friends in Lijiang Old Town, ended up eating noodles here.

photos.alt: An Instax print of a person in a black zip hoodie and faded wide jeans, standing on a street at night
photos.title: Old days
photos.description: One of my favorite Instax shot, reminds me the days in highschool
